posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
I hadn't considered selling crocheted Sentinels things, for a couple of reasons. While the materials are relatively cheap, even the simpler ones take a long time to make, much longer than you'd think, so the price would have to be higher than I think is fair for a tiny doll. And more importantly, these aren't my characters and I don't feel that it would be ethical to make money from someone else's creations.

Maybe I could make a few as gifts for people I especially like though. :)

Taking pics of Tiny Crocheted Tachyon might be a problem. How do I get her to keep still? She's pretty stationary at the moment since she has no feet, but once those running shoes go on... I'll try! ;)

Fanatic? I'm not even thinking about Fanatic. Actually, now I am. Hmm. The wings will be okay, I can use a base of pipe cleaners and some fancy edging to suggest the feathers. It's the armour that'll be the problem. Still, once I've messed around with Bunker a bit I'm sure I can get that to work. It's only 3D shapes.
